content: SARIF 2.1.0 (OASIS standard, JSON-based) is the interchange format GitHub Code Scanning (and other security/static-analysis dashboards) ingest: describes tool, rules checked, and per-result location/severity, rendered as inline code annotations and a dashboard of alerts. Primarily a security/static-analysis convention, not a general regression-diff one — relevant to mediadiff mainly as a possible optional output format for teams that already have SARIF-consuming dashboards.
